items.passage0: Our school had Sports Day last Friday. Our class team ran in the relay race. I was nervous, but I ran very fast. Our team won! After the race, we played dodgeball on the playground. It was the best day of the year.
items.passage1: Lisa loves playing badminton. Her brother Tom likes tennis better. A tennis ball is heavier than a badminton shuttlecock. The shuttlecock is very light. On weekends, they play together in the park. Lisa usually wins at badminton, and Tom usually wins at tennis.
items.passage2: In our town game, Ben is a villager who loves playing football. Every morning, he goes jogging around the plaza. I wanted to make him happy, so I gave him a ball. He said, "Let's play together!" We kicked the ball until it got dark. Now he likes me more.
items.passage3: It rained on Tuesday, so we couldn't go to the playground. Our P.E. teacher took us to the gym. We played volleyball and table tennis there. I am not good at volleyball, but I really like table tennis. Exercise is fun, even on a rainy day.
items.passage4: Last winter, my family went to Japan. It was my first time skiing. I fell down many times, but my dad helped me. On the last day, I could ski down the hill without falling. Next winter, I want to try skating on the ice.
